description: Before an agent browses or fetches a site, check if it will get in. Fetches the URL as an AI agent and as a browser, detects bot challenges (CAPTCHAs, DataDome, PerimeterX and other bot walls), reads robots.txt rules for GPTBot/ChatGPT-User/ClaudeBot/Claude-User/PerplexityBot and others, and looks for agent doors (llms.txt, MCP, OpenAPI). Returns verdict: open | challenged | blocked | robots_disallowed | unreachable, plus advice. Read-only. Use it before an automated web task, not for pages you already fetched successfully.
name: check_agent_access
